title: Which one of you did I meet last night
content: Short/stocky, kinda awkward. Said you were an engineer but interested in creative writing. Told me you were on reddit. We spawned together in the mall area and we were immediately put to work to fix some clothes that were messed up on a display , or at least I was. Somebody had tried to hide some weird bag of stuff (looked like dog food or ginger bread men) in the clothes and we were investigating it. It was near the Whole Foods type deli place.
